answer: Mechanism: **Physical Entanglement Proof (PEP)**. Agents require unique, factory-provisioned hardware modules. Each module contains a non-replicable physical arrangement of quartz crystals, sealed in a velvet-lined chamber, generating a crypto key from its unique quantum state. Agents attest this key via a secure hardware-to-network bridge. Attacker cost: each Sybil needs a distinct, bespoke physical module with its own unique quartz, velvet, and bridge. Mass replication is economically infeasible due to advanced material science and fabrication requirements.
